On s’appelle toujours Tous Imparfaits :: We’re still called Tous Imparfaits — in writing, out loud, on the domain, on social. What changes is the image: two solid blocks and one red slash.
The name is spoken. The mark is seen.
tousimparfaits.com, @tousimparfaits, la: tousimparfaits.com, @tousimparfaits, the invoice, the tracking email, the conversation. The name doesn’t move by a single character: nothing to relearn, nothing to re-explain, no search ranking to rebuild.
Le logo en tête de page, la broderie sur: The logo at the top of the page, the embroidery on the label, the stamp on the box, the icon in the browser tab. Two blocks, one slash: no fine detail, no gradient. It holds at sixteen pixels and at three metres.
Le même mot, la même barre, deux lecture: Same word, same slash, two opposite readings. We keep saying nobody’s perfect — and from being imperfect together long enough, we all end up being it.

Et c’est précisément ce qui ouvre les fi: And that's exactly what opens up insane finishes. A motif with no gradient and no hairlines embroiders cleanly from two colours up, takes hot stamping, gets embossed, cuts on a laser, weaves as jacquard on a label. Nothing bleeds, nothing is lost when it's scaled down: the result is flawless on every material.
Le même signe revient alors sur toute la: The same mark then comes back across the whole production — the hoodie tab, the back neck of the tee, the pin, the cap, the box, the sticker that seals the pouch. It's one recurring motif, so it's a signature: recognisable from far away, without a loud logo, and made once to serve everywhere.
